swus.primary_behavior: Decide whether one candidate ProjectRecord is admitted under the approved Co-Op card policy.
swus.acceptance_boundary: The normalized Poker record is admitted and independent policy, stale, missing-truth, and visibility mutations are rejected with stable intended diagnostics.
forbidden_scope: any network, persistence, hosting, deployment, or public-release artifact
any project source outside the four declared files
done_criteria: record, visibility, policy, admission-result, and diagnostic types are explicit
admission uses injected asOf and stable diagnostic ordering
approved 72-hour SLA and 30-day expiry rules are enforced
every required field path has one known visibility class
independent negative mutations fail for their intended reason

swus.primary_behavior: Render one self-contained semantic HTML content and information-architecture prototype containing the Co-Op invitation, 45-minute route, and exactly fourteen claim-bounded project opportunities.
swus.acceptance_boundary: A real browser at desktop and mobile viewports exposes the complete semantic narrative and fourteen unique project articles, preserves meaning without horizontal overflow, emits no console errors or external requests, and yields review screenshots without implementing exchange behavior.
forbidden_scope: JavaScript, forms, offer submission, collaboration transitions, network calls, storage, persistence, hosting, deployment, or public-release artifacts
private source paths, authoring metadata, participant data, or presenter-only content
final Whisper copy or claims that browser, privacy, comprehension, coherence, recruitment, meeting, or publication audits passed
done_criteria: one dependency-free HTML file opens locally without a build step
semantic landmarks, skip navigation, heading hierarchy, and anchor navigation are present
the invitation, experiment-exchange honesty boundary, seven-day loop, 45-minute route, and participation choices are visible
exactly fourteen unique project articles use the approved display labels and claim ceilings
every project article has current bounded description, explicit limitation, seven-day act, and human contribution ask
no script, form, external resource, network request, browser storage, private metadata, or operational exchange state exists
desktop and mobile browser probes show no horizontal overflow or missing project content
console and request review are clean and desktop/mobile screenshots are captured
